apps.name: NFC Archiver
apps.subtitle: Store files across NFC tags
apps.localizedDescription:
Split any file into parts and write them to NFC tags. Scan the tags back in any order to reassemble and restore the original file.

Features:
• File and text archiving across as many NFC tags as it takes
• Restore by scanning tags in any order; every chunk is CRC32-checked
• Optional GZIP compression to need fewer tags
• Optional AES-256-GCM encryption with a password (PBKDF2 key derivation)
• Open restored files in another app, save them to Files, or share them
• Chameleon Ultra over Bluetooth: use it as the reader, which also unlocks MIFARE Classic 1K cards (752 usable bytes per card) and the card inspector
• Works fully offline. No tracking, no ads, no account

Supported tags with the iPhone's own NFC: NTAG213 (144 bytes), NTAG215 (504 bytes), NTAG216 (888 bytes). MIFARE Classic needs a Chameleon Ultra, because iPhones cannot talk to it directly.

Archives use the open NFAR v1 format and are byte-compatible with the Android app and the web app at nfcarchiver.com/app.

NFC Archiver is free and open source: https://github.com/mezinster/nfcarchiver
